title: Temperature Scaling for a Small Classifier
title_en: Temperature Scaling for a Small Classifier
summary: Temperature scaling improves calibration on a held-out evaluation while preserving the predicted class.
summary_en: Temperature scaling improves calibration on a held-out evaluation while preserving the predicted class.

nodes.label: Deployment confidence
nodes.detail: Confidence estimates are needed for deployment decisions. The tutorial paper studies whether a simple calibration step can make those estimates more reliable.
nodes.detail_en: Confidence estimates are needed for deployment decisions. The tutorial paper studies whether a simple calibration step can make those estimates more reliable.

nodes.label: Baseline miscalibration
nodes.detail: On 1,000 held-out examples, the uncalibrated baseline reached 78.0% accuracy and had an expected calibration error of 0.12.
nodes.detail_en: On 1,000 held-out examples, the uncalibrated baseline reached 78.0% accuracy and had an expected calibration error of 0.12.

nodes.label: Temperature scaling
nodes.detail: The proposed calibration step applies temperature scaling with a temperature of 1.5. This changes confidence values while preserving the predicted class.
nodes.detail_en: The proposed calibration step applies temperature scaling with a temperature of 1.5. This changes confidence values while preserving the predicted class.
nodes.quote: Calibration improves reliability without changing the predicted class.

nodes.label: Held-out evaluation
nodes.detail: The calibrated and uncalibrated models are compared on the same 1,000 held-out examples. The evaluation measures both accuracy and expected calibration error.
nodes.detail_en: The calibrated and uncalibrated models are compared on the same 1,000 held-out examples. The evaluation measures both accuracy and expected calibration error.

nodes.label: Improved calibration
nodes.detail: The calibrated model retained 78.0% accuracy and reduced expected calibration error to 0.07. The comparison is limited to the 1,000-example held-out set.
nodes.detail_en: The calibrated model retained 78.0% accuracy and reduced expected calibration error to 0.07. The comparison is limited to the 1,000-example held-out set.

nodes.label: Reliable confidence
nodes.detail: The result supports using temperature scaling when confidence estimates are needed for deployment. The evidence does not establish performance outside the held-out evaluation.
nodes.detail_en: The result supports using temperature scaling when confidence estimates are needed for deployment. The evidence does not establish performance outside the held-out evaluation.
